daemon_run_as_daemon.description: Whether lbcd should run as a background daemon (true) or foreground (false).

daemon_run_as_user.description: User account under which lbcd runs (for security).

daemon_run_as_group.description: Group account under which lbcd runs.

daemon_pidfile.description: Path to the PID file used by lbcd for process tracking.

logging_log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (errors only) to 3 (debug). Higher values produce more verbose logs.

logging_log_destination.description: Where to send log messages. Use 'file' to write to a log file, 'syslog' for system logging, or 'stdout' for console output.

logging_log_file.description: Path to the log file when log_destination=file.

server_bind_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) on which lbcd listens for incoming connections.

server_bind_port.description: TCP port number on which lbcd accepts client connections.

server_max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections lbcd will handle.

items.description: A single backend server for load balancing.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the backend server.

port.description: Port number on which the backend service runs.

weight.description: Relative capacity (1–1000); higher weight = more requests routed here.

enabled.description: Whether this backend is active and receives traffic.

healthcheck_enabled.description: Enable automatic health monitoring of backend servers.

healthcheck_interval.description: Seconds between consecutive health checks of all backends.

healthcheck_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a health check response before marking as failed.

healthcheck_failure_count.description: Number of consecutive failed health checks before marking a backend as down.

healthcheck_success_count.description: Number of consecutive successful health checks before marking a backend as up.

failover_strategy.description: Algorithm to distribute traffic across healthy backends.

failover_preserve_client_ip.description: Preserve client's source IP in forwarded requests (requires kernel support and may affect balancing fairness).

failover_grace_period.description: Seconds lbcd waits before removing a failed backend from the rotation (allows quick recovery).
